name: Excellence
overview: Scripture highlights excellence as a reflection of a committed heart and spirit dedicated to God’s ways. The example of Daniel, who was esteemed for his excellent spirit and understanding, demonstrates how striving for excellence leads to divine favor and elevated responsibility (Daniel 5:12; 6:3). Likewise, diligent service done with a willing heart as unto the Lord exemplifies excellence in action (Ephesians 6:7). Excellence also involves careful attention to God’s Word and wise living, which brings prosperity and success (Joshua 1:8; Proverbs 22:29), underscoring that excellence is both a pursuit of character and conduct rooted in faithfulness and knowledge.
